snippet.title: Blood in the Panopticon - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Upcoming Indie ASCII Action Roguelike with retro-horror atmosphere, where you guide a deadly Android through violent runs while managing the damage, trust, and consequences that follow.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4109210/Blood_in_the_Panopticon/

More details: https://sebastiandokia.com/blood-in-the-panopticon
